import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod = 1000000009L;
    static final long INF = mod * mod;
    static final int MAX_N = 1 << 18;
    static final int MAX_J = 501;
    static final int MAX_I = 502;

    static class Pair {
        long first, second;
        Pair(long first, long second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
        Pair add(Pair other) {
            return new Pair(this.first + other.first, this.second + other.second);
        }
        Pair mul(Pair other) {
            return new Pair(this.first * other.first, this.second * other.first + this.first * other.second);
        }
    }

    static class ModInt {
        long n;
        ModInt() { this.n = 0; }
        ModInt(long m) {
            this.n = m % mod;
            if (this.n < 0) this.n += mod;
        }
        public int toInt() { return (int)this.n; }
        public static ModInt operatorPlus(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.n + b.n);
        }
        public static ModInt operatorMinus(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.n - b.n);
        }
        public static ModInt operatorTimes(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.n * b.n);
        }
        public static ModInt operatorPow(ModInt a, long n) {
            if (n == 0) return new ModInt(1);
            ModInt res = operatorTimes(a, a).operatorPow(a, n / 2);
            if (n % 2 == 1) res = operatorTimes(res, a);
            return res;
        }
        public static ModInt operatorDivide(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return a.operatorTimes(new ModInt(inv(b.n, mod)));
        }
    }

    static long inv(long a, long p) {
        if (a == 1) return 1;
        return (1 - p * inv(p % a, a)) / a + p;
    }

    static ModInt[] fact = new ModInt[MAX_N];
    static ModInt[] factinv = new ModInt[MAX_N];

    static void init_f() {
        fact[0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N - 1; i++) {
            fact[i + 1] = fact[i].operatorTimes(new ModInt(i + 1));
        }
        factinv[MAX_N - 1] = new ModInt(1).operatorDivide(fact[MAX_N - 1]);
        for (int i = MAX_N - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            factinv[i] = factinv[i + 1].operatorTimes(new ModInt(i + 1));
        }
    }

    static ModInt comb(int a, int b) {
        if (a < 0 || b < 0 || a < b) return new ModInt(0);
        return fact[a].operatorTimes(factinv[b]).operatorTimes(factinv[a - b]);
    }

    static Pair[] dp = new Pair[MAX_J];
    static boolean[] used = new boolean[MAX_J];

    static void init() {
        init_f();
        dp[0] = new Pair(1, 0);
        dp[1] = new Pair(2, 0);
        for (int n = 2; n <= 500; n++) {
            Pair sumPair = new Pair(0, 0);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                long cnt = n + 1;
                long sum = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    sum += Math.abs(j - k);
                }
                Pair cl = dp[j];
                Pair cr = dp[n - 1 - j];
                Pair x = cl.mul(cr);
                x = new Pair(x.first * comb(n - 1, j).toInt(), x.second * comb(n - 1, j).toInt());
                x = new Pair(x.first * cnt, x.second * cnt + sum * x.first);
                sumPair = sumPair.add(x);
            }
            dp[n] = sumPair;
        }
    }

    static Pair[][] dp2 = new Pair[MAX_I][MAX_J];

    static void solve() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        init();

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_I; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_J; j++) {
                dp2[i][j] = new Pair(0, 0);
            }
        }
        dp2[0][0] = new Pair(1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
                for (int j = i; j < n; j++) {
                    int ni = j + 2;
                    if (ni > n) ni = n;
                    int nk = k + j - i + 1;
                    if (nk <= m) {
                        Pair x = dp2[i][k].mul(dp[j - i + 1]);
                        x = new Pair(x.first * comb(nk, k).toInt(), x.second * comb(nk, k).toInt());
                        dp2[ni][nk] = dp2[ni][nk].add(x);
                    }
                }
                dp2[i + 1][k] = dp2[i + 1][k].add(dp2[i][k]);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dp2[n][m].second);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        solve();
    }
}
